regions.today: Blustery with a mix of cloud and sunny spells for the rest of today. Scattered showers will become isolated this evening as moderate to fresh and gusty westerly winds ease somewhat.
regions.tonight: Largely dry tonight with clear spells and isolated showers. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 11 degrees in light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Mostly dry on Thursday with spells of sunshine, hazy at times. A few isolated showers are possible. Top temperatures of 17 to 21 degrees in light to moderate westerly winds. Mildest in the south and southeast.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Thursday. Moderate Friday.
